name: Tanmay
player_statement:
A complete player, Tanmay has made a big mark in cricket. With 13 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 46, with an average of 13.09 and a quick strike rate of 132.11. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 14 sixes and 7 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 6.0 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 8.17. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
